title: Saaday Chaawal (Plain Basmati Rice)

source.text: S. Abbas Raza, Pakistani & North Indian Cooking (2015)

description: Plain basmati cooked so the long grains stay separate. Normally eaten with daal spooned over it, plus a meat or vegetable dish.

steps.action: Rinse in a large pot until the water runs almost clear (removes starch that makes grains stick); drain well:
Add and bring to a boil on high:
items: 1 tsp salt (optional; the author leaves it out)

steps.action: Cover tightly; cook on low (2/10) exactly 23 min. Turn off heat and rest covered 5 min. Never lift the lid while cooking.
